name: stress-network
description: Stress test network workloads (request §18-19, §33-46): the reconnect churn at 25 / 50 / 100 players (20 cycles each), lag compensation by ping group at 50, the join ramp to 100 players at 5 / 10 / 20 per second, the join spike of 100, the disconnect spike of 50, invalid packets from 10 % abusers (5/s and 50/s) and the mixed network faults at 50. About 25 minutes (estimated from the single runs of 2026-10-02).
